bio.text: Erin Grall represents District 29 in the Florida Senate, to which Grall was elected in 2022 and reelected subsequently.
Grall served in the Florida House of Representatives from 2016 to 2022 and is an attorney who was born in Vero Beach, Florida.
Grall holds a B.A. in communication from Wake Forest University (1999) and a J.D. from Marquette University (2003).
